Final Theses, Project Studies, IDP

Write your Thesis with the Chair of Strategy and Organization!

We’re looking for entrepreneurial thinkers — engaged, creative, and action-oriented!

If you’re driven by curiosity, ready to innovate, and eager to make an impact, our supervision topics are designed for you. Bring your ideas, energy, and ambition — and take the lead on shaping the future.

💡
Thank you for checking out our offers! If you find a topic that interests you, please contact the respective supervisor directly ✍️📩

We have hot topics, all available topics and archived topics.

📝
Application

a) Application for a topic offered by the CSO: Please send the complete application of you or your team (motivation letter, CV of all team members, current transcript of record of all team members) to the respective contact person. Please note that you should normally apply as a team of 2-5 students for a project study or 1-4 students for an IDP.

b) Application with an own topic: Please send your complete application and a short research/project proposal for your topic via email to a supervisor directly. Further information on writing a research/project proposal you find here: [English]. Please note that your proposed topic should be in line with one of the research topics of the CSO. Inform yourself and integrate a clear argument on why your topic fits with the CSO in your exposé.
